youtube.title: Zoomy's Shape Drive! (HONK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 HONK! Zoomy the car honked so loud in the city that all the shapes flew away! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Drive along with Zoomy and learn 7 shapes: circle, triangle, square, rectangle, diamond, oval and hexagon! Each shape comes back one by one in a new place (the road, the city, the park, the sky and the farm), and Zoomy shows where you can spot it, like a circle in Zoomy's wheels, a rectangle door and a diamond kite. Then sing the shape driving song, and stay till the end, because it gets dark and a surprise shape starts to shine! ✨

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 shapes: circle, triangle, square, rectangle, diamond, oval and hexagon
✔️ Count the sides: a triangle has 3, a square has 4, a hexagon has 6
✔️ Spot shapes in everyday things: wheels, doors, kites and eggs
✔️ Sing a happy driving shapes song with Zoomy!
